answer: You can still sell us the car, and you pay the difference at the appointment by cashier's check or debit card. Personal checks and credit cards are not accepted. Lakeshore Bank is in our e-payoff network, so you don't need a payoff letter: we confirm the payoff with them electronically the same day at your appointment, using your loan account number. If you'd rather not pay the difference, you can keep the car, since an offer never obliges you to sell.
